children: Spirax Group needs more than a cyclical improvement, RBC Capital Markets analyst Mark Fielding writes in a note. The British steam-system engineering group said that organic sales growth and adjusted operating profit margin for the ten months ended Oct. 31 were in line with expectations, and maintained its guidance for the year as a whole. "We expect cyclical improvement to continue in 2026," he says. However, a rerating of the shares requires "more than just a cyclical uptick." The analyst doesn't expect significant changes to consensus expectations for the full year. RBC maintains its underperform rating on the stock. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
